name: TerraPower
short_description: Bill Gates-backed developer of sodium fast reactors and the Natrium SMR.
why_relevant: First advanced-reactor construction start permitted in the US in decades.

name: Commonwealth Fusion Systems
short_description: Spinout of MIT using high-temperature superconducting magnets for SPARC.
why_relevant: The fusion company that says power on the grid before 2035.

name: Helion Energy
short_description: Pulsed, fuel-mixture fusion approach already selling first electricity agreements.
why_relevant: Signed a world-first fusion electricity purchase agreement.

name: TAE Technologies
short_description: The longest-running private fusion company, now building Copernicus.
why_relevant: Decades of deuterium-boron approach for aneutronic power.

name: General Fusion
short_description: Canada's leading magnetized-target approach to commercial fusion.
why_relevant: Institution-scale asset that British Columbia has scoped into a demo plant.

name: Radiant Nuclear
short_description: Develops kilo-watt scale modular nuclear reactors for remote microgrids.
why_relevant: Turnkey hot swap truck-mounted reactors for power in a crate.

name: NuScale Power
short_description: First SMR design to receive US NRC certification.
why_relevant: Certified SMR design comparing economics down under 100 MW.

name: Oklo
short_description: First fast-spectrum microreactor with commercial permits to build.
why_relevant: Deploy-anywhere 15 MW plants with 20-year fuel life.

name: Kairos Power
short_description: Fluoride-salt-cooled high-temperature reactor with rapid prototyping ethos.
why_relevant: Iterative prototyping fixed expensive first-of-a-kind surprises.

name: Oxford PV
short_description: Perovskite-on-silicon tandem solar cells that beat the single-junction limit.
why_relevant: Pushed commercial solar efficiency past the old 30 percent ceiling.

name: Carbon Engineering
short_description: Pioneer of industrial direct air capture of CO2 for 1PointFive conversion.
why_relevant: The DAC blueprint now copied by a dozen carbon-removal startups.

name: Climeworks
short_description: Operates the largest commercial direct air capture plant, Mammoth.
why_relevant: Sells permanent removal at ton-scale to major corporations.

name: Heirloom Carbon
short_description: Accelerates natural limestone-mineral CO2 uptake into days.
why_relevant: Uses carbonate ovens to turn neglected minerals into removal credit mills.

name: Redwood Materials
short_description: Turns end-of-life EV batteries back into cathode and anode materials.
why_relevant: Supply-chain gold from recycling could cover a third of American battery need.

name: Ascend Elements
short_description: Hydro-to-cathode process recycles battery waste into usable cathode powder.
why_relevant: First US gigafactory-scale cathode production from spent cells.

name: Li-Cycle
short_description: Spoke-and-hub lithium-ion recycling network with patented submerged shredding.
why_relevant: No-smelting recycling that recovers 95 percent of critical battery mass.

name: Electric Hydrogen
short_description: Builds gigawatt-scale, low-cost electrolyzers for green hydrogen.
why_relevant: Aims to make hydrogen cost-competitive with fossil across heavy industry.

name: Ohmium
short_description: Modular PEM electrolyzers shipped worldwide for renewable hydrogen.
why_relevant: Containerized electrolyzers turn any grid corner into a clean hydrogen hub.

name: Sublime Systems
short_description: Makes cement with an electrochemical process instead of kilns.
why_relevant: Helps demolish the 8-percent-of-CO2 problem hidden inside concrete.

name: Brimstone Energy
short_description: Produces cement from silicate rocks without releasing process CO2.
why_relevant: Sells a carbonate-negative Portland-cement-equivalent replacement.

name: Boston Metal
short_description: Molten oxide electrolysis makes steel without blast furnaces or carbon.
why_relevant: A path to near-zero-carbon steel without scaling hydrogen plants first.

name: Electra
short_description: Electro-refines steel at low temperatures, cutting its energy needs.
why_relevant: Powered refining opens steelmaking to intermittent renewables.

name: Rondo Energy
short_description: Bricks-based heat storage that dispatches industrial process heat.
why_relevant: Industrial heat being electrified with cheap minerals, not rare materials.

name: Antora Energy
short_description: Carbon-block thermal batteries discharging heat and power on demand.
why_relevant: Bridges the grid with stored heat that converts to dispatchable electricity.

name: Monolith
short_description: Methane pyrolysis splits natural gas into hydrogen and solid carbon black.
why_relevant: Commodity hydrogen without CO2 and a carbon black co-product.

name: Stegra (H2 Green Steel)
short_description: Building a large green hydrogen steel plant in northern Sweden.
why_relevant: Flagship commercial proof that hydrogen steel can be delivered at scale.

name: Twelve
short_description: Electrochemistry turns CO2 into jet fuel, plastics and critical chemicals.
why_relevant: E-Jet fuel from captured CO2 lectured as a practical SAF supply answer.

name: Air Company
short_description: Converts CO2 and water into sustainable aviation fuel and spirits.
why_relevant: Closed-loop fuel and vodka from thin air that customers actually buy.

name: Amogy
short_description: Turns ammonia into electric power for trucks, ships and heavy equipment.
why_relevant: Green ammonia as liquid hydrogen for transport, without cryogenics.

name: ZeroAvia
short_description: Develops hydrogen-electric powertrains for zero-emission regional flight.
why_relevant: World-first fuel-cell commercial aircraft flight at 19-passenger scale.

name: Sunfire
short_description: EU leader in pressurized alkaline and solid-oxide electrolysis.
why_relevant: Efficiency-leading solid-oxide electrolyzers for industrial e-refineries.

name: Verkor
short_description: Building France's battery cell plants for EV artificial intelligence dashboards.
why_relevant: Europe's answer to keeping cell production inside its own supply chain.
